svg.aria-label: Recognition: 2026 UBS Outstanding Performer (Risk Issue Assistant); 2025 UBS Tech Unleashed, Leader's Choice (AI-Architect); 2025 UBS Data Science Guild Hackathon, Winner (AI-Architect); 2024 NES Innovation Awards, 2nd (drone pollution mapping); 2023 NASA Space Apps Challenge, Winner (deforestation detection). Stack: Python, TypeScript, Dart, Swift, SQL, RAG, MCP, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, PyTorch, Docker.
